findings.title: One-sided termination for convenience
findings.deviation: Clause 8.3 permits only TravelHub to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice, without a corresponding right for AtliQ.
findings.impact: AtliQ lacks the ability to terminate the contract for convenience if project circumstances change.
findings.quote: TravelHub may terminate for convenience with thirty (30) days' written notice and shall pay for all work performed up to the termination date.
findings.counterPosition: Make the termination for convenience right mutual, or ensure AtliQ has a corresponding right.

findings.title: Restriction on offshore data transfer without prior written approval
findings.deviation: Clause 14.2 prohibits transferring Customer Data outside the TravelHub cloud environment without prior written approval, which impacts offshore delivery (e.g., AtliQ's Pune entity).
findings.impact: AtliQ's offshore engineering team may be blocked from accessing or processing data without separate written approval from TravelHub.
findings.quote: AtliQ shall not transfer Customer Data outside the TravelHub cloud environment without prior written approval.
findings.counterPosition: Agree on an explicit offshore access route in writing or incorporate an approved sub-processor/offshore clause for AtliQ's Pune entity.

fine.note: Liability is mutually capped at 1x prior 12 months fees with appropriate carve-outs
Indemnities are mutual and standard for IP infringement and customer data
IP ownership and background technology licence match standard
Confidentiality obligations are mutual with a standard 3-year survival
Restrictive covenants limited to a mutual 12-month staff non-solicit
No insurance requirements imposed in the draft agreement
Acceptance procedure and deemed acceptance timeline are reasonable
Warranty terms and 60-day post-acceptance defect period match standard
